test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Maria was unhappy / because she terribly performed / in the examination / conducted last month.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. because she terribly performed .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The segment "because she terribly performed" contains the error.
 
• The adverb "terribly" should be positioned correctly to modify the verb "performed".
 
• The correct placement of the adverb should be after the verb in this context, i.e., "performed terribly".

Correct sentence: *Maria was unhappy because she performed terribly in the examination conducted last month.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adverb Placement: **

 
 
• Adverbs modifying verbs are typically placed immediately before or after the verb they modify depending on their emphasis.
 
• Example: "She sings beautifully" (the adverb "beautifully" modifies the verb "sings").
 
 
 
• **Correct Usage:**
 
 
• Example: "He quickly ran to the store" (the adverb "quickly" modifies the verb "ran").
 
• Incorrect: "He ran quick to the store." Correct: "He ran quickly to the store."
